hypothesis: Within-root terminal-margin targets over post-action semantic pair features improve disjoint calibration root Top-1 over static order and state-value v2.
single_variable: Learning target changed from state winner classification to within-root action preference; representation and protocol otherwise frozen.
notes: No Top-1 or regret gain. The production action has the same sole semantic delta (inventoryTotal +3) but terminal-margin effects of +76 in development and -10 in calibration, proving the linear absolute post-state representation cannot express the needed context-dependent sign. An earlier all-deterministic collection was discarded after exceeding the 700-command bound; no partial labels were retained.
